english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the speaker is certain that something is true.
This is the all-purpose choice for being personally confident that something is true.
This is the all-purpose choice when you are very sure that something is true.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for being certain or firmly believing something.
Use this all-purpose choice when you are certain or fully confident that something is true.
Use this when satisfied means convinced or sure on the basis of evidence.
Use this when stressing that a person is sure or has no doubt, rather than that a matter has been formally settled.
Use this when secure means confident or certain, as in being sure of a welcome.
